_note: Defaults for atrium/config.json keys newer than a copy that ATRIUM_CONFIG (or a test) may point at: atrium/suggest.py lays config.json's "suggest" over this one, key by key. Edit config.json, not this file.

suggest._note: atrium/suggest.py: the live page's Do next card, the 3 things to do now. Facts are read from the vault notes and plan files below plus Orchestra's needs-you items; the local model (through local_llm: the GPU lease, one num_ctx, a timeout) ranks them as strict JSON; Ollama down, the lease held, or a reply that is not valid JSON = the rules ranking (soonest deadline, then behind, then oldest waiting) under the words.mode_rules label. The model runs in the background and only while Ollama answers; the page never waits on it, and a result is kept for suggest_refresh_minutes or until a fact changes (hot.md, the queue, a note). Done/snooze state: state_file (inside .review), written only by the card's buttons. Same keys in atrium/config_defaults.json. Source roots: vault (vault-relative), repo (repo-relative) or home (home-relative); {today} = YYYY-MM-DD.
suggest._days_off: Weekday names, as %A prints them. On a day off no study is suggested; only non-study items due within urgent_days, else words.day_off.
suggest._study_slots: His best study slots (HH:MM, local): afternoons between lectures, and after lectures before dinner. Inside one, study goes first among items equally due.
suggest._sources: mode lines = each bullet or table row of section is one fact (hot.md's waiting list; strike true = Done strikes the exact line); note = each matching note is one fact (the sections listed, else the body; last_lines keeps the newest lines), titled by title; sections = each ## section is a fact, and only the next upcoming one (by the last date in its heading) is offered. glob may match many files; skip_between drops a generated block; rank false = the model sees it, the rules ranking never offers it.
suggest._dates: Deadlines are dates found in a fact: patterns with named groups y/m/d (numbers) or d/mon (mon = one of months, by its first three letters). No year: this year, or next year when that is more than past_grace_days ago. A fact's deadline is its soonest date not yet past (a sections fact: the last date in its heading).
suggest._behind: Only for the rules ranking (the model judges this itself): a fact matching one of these is one he is behind on.
suggest._guard: Checked on every suggestion, the model's and the rules': drop = never shown (no buy/sell/hold advice: markets are information only); draft = rewritten with draft_template unless it already matches unless (nothing is sent as him).

prompt: You plan Chuen's next hour. It is {weekday} {now}. Day off today: {day_off}. In a study slot now: {in_slot} (his slots: {slots}).
From the facts below, pick the {n} things he should do now, most important first.
Rules: on a day off suggest no study, only urgent non-study items. Prefer study inside his study slots.
Never suggest buying, selling or holding any investment. Never suggest sending anything as him: at most 'draft a reply to X'.
Each item: title (short, an action), why (one line, blunt when he is behind), minutes (an integer), source (the id of the fact it came from, exactly as given), kind (one of {kinds}).
